headline: Frontline Shifts Intensify Across Multiple Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition the war‑map has shown a surge of localized base turnover while the broader front remains locked in grinding attrition. Fishermans Row has become the most volatile hex, recording three captures in the past two hours, eight in six and twenty‑three over the day, with Peripti Landing and Dankana Post the busiest sites. Dead Lands continues to bleed men — over 1,700 colonial and 2,200 warden casualties in the last two hours — yet ownership changes have slowed to three flips in six hours and sixteen in twenty‑four. Godcrofts added a fresh capture in the last two hours and nine total today, centred on Argosa and Lipsia. Stema Landing, previously quiet, erupted with four events in two hours and six in six, all at The Wane. Lykos Isle saw three new flips in six hours, focused on Fort Guile and The Squall. Meanwhile the massive attrition zones — Weathered Expanse, Callahans Passage, Kings Cage, Marban Hollow, Loch Mor, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle — keep posting rising casualty rates but no territorial movement. Overall strategic‑base ownership remains largely unchanged, with the Colonials holding the western and southern belts and the Wardens the northern and eastern arcs.
